checks.why: a name a library re-exports with `from M import *` is M's class: Table.get, inherited through the star module, calls back the client's __getitem__
a dotted base (`class DottedStore(mb.Table)`) names the library class through its attribute chain
a generic alias a library builds around a class (`Table = _Alias(mixkit.abc.Table, 2)`) is that class
CONTROL: a library base whose get() hands nothing back never reaches the client's __getitem__
